role: The "move" kind of the probe: random Entity.moveEntity calls of a never-ticked ProbeEntity on raw terrain scattered with non-full-cube collision shapes, teleported every 50 moves; the reference for the native collision physics.
used_by: make -C oracle probe KIND=move (Probe.dump dispatches kind move to Move.dump)
notes: Output shapes.bin and moves.bin; its local RNG does not touch CLIENT or SERVER streams.
